# Velvame

> Premium health & wellness eCommerce platform with a member rewards program. Members unlock distributor pricing and earn level-based commissions on referrals.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, offers, and brand story.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse the full catalog of health & wellness products.
- [Offers](/offers): Active discounts, coupons, and seasonal promotions.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, and company values.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Velvame team.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about products, membership, and rewards.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Member sign-in.
- [Register](/register): Create a new account.
